t: Multi-material screw with twin-cut technology. Ideal for applications when optimum holding force is required, such as hinges, brackets and high load environments. Features deep recess to prevent cam-out, giving precise and positive drive control. Under-head ribs prevent splitting and material damage, with improved countersinking for a smooth, flush finish. Coated with high-molecular polymer lubricant which reduces insertion torque and increases rust protection.
b: Single Thread Grips the Wood for a Secure Fix
